heading: Council Approves Amended Ten-Year Capital Plan
summary: The Common Council approved the amended 2027–2036 capital improvement plan in an 8–0 vote. Alders first voted unanimously on an amendment and then took a separate vote on the full plan. The capital plan covers a decade of planned city investments.

heading: Wisconsin Confirms Travel-Related Measles Case in Marathon County
summary: State and local health officials confirmed measles in a Marathon County resident. DHS said the resident was exposed during out-of-state travel. The department said the case was unrelated to the southwestern Wisconsin outbreak.
